{{nihongo|'''Moritano Shrine'''|守田迺神社}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Shinano Province]].

'''Moritano Shrine''' (もりたのじんじゃ) is a {{ill|Shinto shrine|abstract|Q845945|ar|جينجا|arz|ضريح شنتو|bcl|Shinto shrine|ca|Jinja|cs|Šintoistická svatyně|da|Shinto-tempel|de|Shintō-Schrein|el|Σιντοϊστικό Ιερό|eo|Ŝintoa sanktejo|es|Jinja|eu|Jinja|fa|معبد شینتویی|fi|Šintolainen pyhäkkö|fr|Sanctuaire shinto|hi|शिंतो मंदिर|hr|Šintoistički hram|hu|Sintó szentély|id|Jinja|it|Jinja|ja|神社|ka|ძინძია|ko|신사 (신토)|lb|Shintō-Schräin|mr|शिंतो मंदिर|nl|Jinja (heiligdom)|no|Jinja|or|ଜିଞ୍ଜା|pl|Jinja|pt|Templo xintoísta|ru|Дзиндзя|sc|Jinja|simple|Shinto shrine|sl|Šintoistično svetišče|sr|Шинтоистички храм|sv|Jinja|th|ศาลเจ้าชินโต|tok|tomo sewi pi nasin sewi Sinto|tr|Şinto tapınağı|uk|Святилище (синто)|uz|Dzindzya|vi|Thần xã|wuu|神社|zh|神社|zh_yue|神社|qid=Q845945}} ({{ill|Son-sha|Q134917284|qid=Q134917284}}) located in {{ill|Takada|ja|高田 (長野市)|qid=Q11672003|lt=Takada}}, {{ill|Nagano (city)|Q128849|qid=Q128849}}, {{ill|Nagano Prefecture|Q127877|qid=Q127877}}. It is commonly known as '''Morita Shrine'''.

It is identified with the Morita Shrine listed as a {{ill|Shikinaisha|fr|Shikinaisha|zh|式內社|qid=Q134917286|lt=Shikinaisha}}.

=== Overview ===
The shrine is located in a {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=residential area}} in the eastern part of Nagano City, one street removed from the bustle of {{ill|Japan National Route 19|af|Japan Nasionale Roete 19|de|Nationalstraße 19 (Japan)|ja|国道19号|ko|국도 제19호선 (일본)|zh|国道19号 (日本)|zh_min_nan|Ji̍t-pún Kok-tō 19-hō|qid=Q899326}}.

Although the date of foundation is unknown, it was formerly called '''Morita Hachimangū''' and served as the {{ill|Ubusunagami|ja|産土神|ko|산토신|zh|產土神|qid=Q1392097}} (tutelary deity) of the former {{ill|Kita-Takada Village|ja|高田 (長野市)|qid=Q11672003|lt=Kita-Takada Village}}<ref>[http://www.komakichiku.com/siseki/ Our Town’s Historic Sites and Cultural Properties] – Komaki District Residents’自治 Council</ref>. يىلى|uk|1756|ur|1756ء|uz|1756|vec|1756|vi|1756|vls|1756|vo|1756|wa|1756|war|1756|wuu|1756年|xmf|1756|yi|1756|zea|1756|zh|1756年|zh_min_nan|1756 nî|zh_yue|1756年|qid=Q7632}} ({{ill|Hōreki|Q1194397|qid=Q1194397}} 8), it received {{ill|Hanpei|ja|幣帛|qid=Q11481885}} under the name '''Morita Shrine''' from the {{ill|Yoshida family|fr|Clan Yoshida|ja|吉田家|ko|요시다가|simple|Yoshida family|qid=Q11413722}} of {{ill|Kannushi|ca|Kannushi|de|Shinshoku|es|Kannushi|fa|کاننوشی|fi|Kannushi|fr|Kannushi|id|Kannushi|it|Kannushi|ja|神職|jv|Kannushi|ko|신쇼쿠|ms|Kannushi|or|କାନ୍ନୁଶୀ|pl|Kannushi|ru|Каннуси|te|కన్నూషి|th|คันนูชิ|tr|Kannushi|uk|Каннусі|zh|神職 (神道)|qid=Q60523}}. However, during the Shikinaisha naming dispute in {{ill|1839|ab|1839|af|1839|als|1839|am|1839 እ.ኤ.አ.|an|1839|ar|1839|ary|1839|arz|1839|ast|1839|avk|1839|az|1839|azb|۱۸۳۹ (میلادی)|ba|1839 йыл|ban|1839|bar|1839|bat_smg|1839|bcl|1839|be|1839|be_x_old|1839|bg|1839|bn|১৮৩৯|bpy|মারি ১৮৩৯|br|1839|bs|1839.|ca|1839|cdo|1839 nièng|ce|1839 шо|ceb|1839|ckb|١٨٣٩|crh|1839|cs|1839|csb|1839|cv|1839|cy|1839|da|1839|de|1839|diq|1839|el|1839|eml|1839|eo|1839|es|1839|et|1839|eu|1839|fa|۱۸۳۹ (میلادی)|fi|1839|fiu_vro|1839|fo|1839|fr|1839|frp|1839|frr|1839|fur|1839|fy|1839|ga|1839|gan|1839年|gcr|1839|gd|1839|gl|1839|gn|1839|gv|1839|he|1839|hi|१८३९|hif|1839|hr|1839.|hsb|1839|ht|1839 (almanak gregoryen)|hu|1839|hy|1839|hyw|1839 թուական|ia|1839|id|1839|ilo|1839|io|1839|is|1839|it|1839|ja|1839年|jv|1839|ka|1839|kaa|1839|kk|1839 жыл|kn|೧೮೩೯|ko|1839년|krc|1839 джыл|ksh|Joohr 1839|kv|1839-ӧд во|la|1839|lb|1839|lez|1839 йис|li|1839|lij|1839|lmo|1839|lt|1839 m.|lv|1839. gads|mai|१८३९|map_bms|1839|mdf|1839|mg|1839|mhr|1839|mi|1839|min|1839|mk|1839|mr|इ.स. १८३९|mrj|1839 и|ms|1839|my|၁၈၃၉|myv|1839 ие|mzn|۱۸۳۹|nah|1839|nap|1839|nds|1839|new|ई सं १८३९|nl|1839|nn|1839|no|1839|nrm|1839|nso|1839|oc|1839|olo|1839|or|୧୮୩୯|os|1839-æм аз|pa|1839|pl|1839|pnb|1839|pt|1839|qu|1839|ro|1839|ru|1839 год|rue|1839|sa|१८३९|sah|1839|scn|1839|sco|1839|sd|1839ع|se|1839|sh|1839.|shn|1839|simple|1839|sk|1839|sl|1839|smn|1839|sq|1839|sr|1839|stq|1839|su|1839|sv|1839|sw|1839|szl|1839|ta|1839|te|1839|tg|Соли 1839|th|พ.ศ. 2382|tk|1839|tl|1839|tly|1839|tpi|1839|tr|1839|tt|1839 ел|udm|1839 ар|uk|1839|ur|1839ء|uz|1839|vec|1839|vi|1839|vls|1839|vo|1839|wa|1839|war|1839|wuu|1839年|xmf|1839|yi|1839|za|1839 nienz|zea|1839|zh|1839年|zh_classical|一八三九年|zh_min_nan|1839 nî|zh_yue|1839年|qid=Q7616}} ({{ill|Tenpō|Q1369045|qid=Q1369045}} 10), the character “迺 (or 廼)” was added to its name.

The main hall was formerly the Year Deity Hall of {{ill|Zenkō-ji|Q189640|qid=Q189640}}. When the Year Deity Hall was relocated from the Zenkō-ji precincts to {{ill|Jōyama Park|Q11426101|qid=Q11426101|lt=Joyama}} as {{ill|Takeminakata|es|Takeminakata|hu|Takeminakata|id|Takeminakata|ja|タケミナカタ|mni|ꯇꯀꯦꯃꯤꯅꯀꯇ|pl|Takeminakata|zh|建御名方神|qid=Q9150391|lt=Takeminakata Tomino Mikoto Hikokamiwake Shrine}} (Minochi Taisha) following the {{ill|Shinbutsu bunri|Q1970535|qid=Q1970535}}, only the building was transferred to this shrine<ref>[http://weekly-nagano.main.jp/2011/04/070.html No. 070 Moritano Shrine (Part 2) – The main hall transferred from Zenkō-ji] – Weekly Nagano</ref>.

Because it was relatively close to {{ill|Tsuruga|Q11676187|qid=Q11676187|lt=Tsuruga Shinchi}} (the former Nagano red-light district) and {{ill|Gondōchō|Q11542303|qid=Q11542303|lt=Gondō Town}}, many of the donors’ names carved on the {{ill|Sacred fences|Q3078312|qid=Q3078312}} fence belong to {{ill|Ryōtei|Q2178435|qid=Q2178435}} restaurants and brothels<ref>[http://weekly-nagano.main.jp/2011/04/069.html No. 069 Moritano Shrine (Part 1) – Names of restaurants and pleasure quarters on the fence] – Weekly Nagano</ref>.

=== History ===
